description: Statutory approval pathway gating a data centre build. Each entry becomes a gating milestone with a finish-to-start constraint (DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5).
provenance_summary: MIXED, and the split matters. The AUTHORITY NAMES and the existence of each approval are transcribed from DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5, which names CIDCO/MIDC, SEIAA, State PCB, State Fire Services, CEIG, PESO, CGWA, AAI and DoT. Every DURATION and every SEQUENCE POSITION is INVENTED BY THE MODEL. DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5 states plainly that the exact set varies by city, parcel and project and is confirmed with the client's compliance team - so this file is a template of the right shape, not a statement of what this project actually needs. It is NOT legal advice. The compliance register must be marked approved in admin (ADMIN_SPEC.md section 4) before it can drive a live plan.
